same_root_cold_switch_contract: Refresh all three prior native terminal records, cumulative ledgers, pending updates, mutation intents, and old controller/physical/aux process identities before changing the current manifest pointer.

Keep every old source capsule, worker manifest, request, outcome, checkpoint, audit and STOP byte unchanged. Save the former current RUN_MANIFEST bytes under an immutable sealed history path before atomically advancing the same run's current manifest.
Both nodes stage and validate new immutable capsules and node-specific manifest/closure receipts; do not dispatch unless both cold deployment readbacks pass.

Pin the unique immutable WORKER_RUN_MANIFEST in the cold batch environment and force server metadata for the current manifest pointer during cold admission, so a stale NFS current pointer cannot silently select an old source.

All non-code scientific fields, entry identity, existing sealed inputs, original source-family counters, limits, clocks and owner remain unchanged. No new namespace that resets counters or attempt rights.

Require byte equality of original model/training/trainer/dataset/native preprocessing/numerics/plant/S1/scorer modules and the original fifteen frozen numerical members. Only heartbeat observation, engineering-stop resolution and associated admission metadata are changed.

The retained original engineering STOP remains sealed at its original path/hash. A bound alloc04 closure permits only its already-reconciled inbox-only orphan; no native safety STOP can be resolved by this mechanism.
Any new alloc04 poisoned session writes a separate immutable engineering STOP and blocks all subsequent phases. The old STOP is not removed, renamed or overwritten.

heartbeat_qualification.before_any_model_load: Inside the exact admitted PBS allocation, force server metadata and bounded parent enumeration, then read and validate the actual local-owner heartbeat. Record the exact timestamp, age and native job identity.
heartbeat_qualification.during_existing_guard_calls: On an expired/future cached age, revalidate metadata and reread once; enforce the same original 0..300 second threshold. Record actual cached and revalidated values; true owner loss still stops.
